details.method: Bind each missing digest to its original receipt and field. Check the recorded source candidate, patch or archived literal, reproduce the exact bytes when possible, then archive and independently rehash each distinct file.
details.when: The original receipt supplies a content digest and names the producer, file or immutable candidate.
details.counterexample: An archive hash, same-named executable or successful replacement run cannot identify the historical file. A byte match alone cannot verify a past execution.
details.trial_plan: On another frozen receipt list recover bytes by a recorded source, verify every original field, reject a one-byte mutation, and keep any unmatched observations open.
